newsitem.title: UK: Rolling Stone Jagger set for divorce - papers.
newsitem.headline: Rolling Stone Jagger set for divorce - papers.

text.p: The wife of Rolling Stones' lead singer Mick Jagger, American model Jerry Hall, has started divorce proceedings, British newspapers reported on Wednesday.
The tabloid Sun said Hall had consulted top divorce lawyer Anthony Julius, who negotiated Princess Diana's multi-million dollar split from Britain's heir-to-the-throne Prince Charles.
Julius said on Tuesday he had nothing to say about the reports that Hall was initiating moves to end her five-year marriage to the rock superstar. The couple have three children.
"I have instructions from my client that I should make no comment in connection with this inquiry," he told the Press Association.
That meant he could neither confirm or deny the report, he said, adding that he did not believe any statement was imminent.
The reported divorce move comes amid reports, the latest of many, that one of the most famous marriages in show business was under a cloud as a result of Jagger's lifestyle.
Earlier this year Hall told an interviewer she never thought life with Jagger would last more than two years.
